review:
A 6x5 scatter-pays cascade game with knights, treasure and Charred Land wild multipliers. Each lands with three charges and a 2x to 10x value – it loses a charge after every win it's part of, but gains +1x every cascade, so it can grow a lot in a long chain.

Several Charred Lands in one win add together, and dragons breathe fire across the board to make more. A clever way to make wilds both grow and burn out. Two bonus games, 10,000x max.
